title: Why Standard Chartered lowered Solana price target for 2026 but raised it to $2,000 by 2030
text: Standard Chartered cut its Solana price prediction for 2026 to $250. The UK-based bank is projecting a $2,000 price tag by 2030. Solana's ultra-low transaction costs enable micropayments that weren't previously economically viable, the bank said.
